Name: Moon's Store Clothing Addons
Author: Moonbein
Description:
I got annoyed that clothing was hard to come by until you had sheep, and that some clothes don't have tailoring recipes. So I learned how to mod because I'm bored and easily annoyed.

Adds clothing (pants and shirts) to the Traveling Merchant, the Hat Mouse, and a few more to Sandy's store. A few randomly selected clothing items will show up in the given shops' inventories. The Hat Mouse gets one, the Traveling Merchant gets five, and Sandy gets two more for a total of three. Almost all clothing is potentially available, save for prismatic clothing and a few pieces that I felt like were rare enough. I priced the clothing around Sandy's store because that made sense, though the Hat Mouse is a bit cheaper because they only get a single item per day.
This mod also works with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9166]Indie's Female Farmer Overhaul[/url] that replace the base game clothing. Mods that add additional clothing will not be natively supported, and a patch will be needed (though those shouldn't be difficult at all to create), so if there's enough demand I'll make one, or if someone else wants to make it, send me a message.

Requirements:
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url](Obviously)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005?tab=files]Shop Tile Framework [/url]
(and their requirements)

Thanks to the amazing folks that made these frameworks!

Installation:
Just unzip the compressed file into your Mods folder. To uninstall: get this, remove the uncompressed file from your Mods folder.

Doesn't seem to be buggy, but who knows! Let me know if you find anything weird. Might make a few different files that just do the individual stores if y'all only want to modify some stores.
